found_at: https://mattermost.com/newsroom/ (the site's Organization logo in its JSON-LD; the header lockup draws the same icon paths in currentColor)
edits: cropped the viewBox to the mark
notes: DECISION: Mattermost's site draws its mark monochrome (currentColor), so this is near-black #1B1D22 on light and white on dark, the company's own two files. If a colour tile is preferred: mattermost.com/favicon.svg (saved as downloads/mattermost/src4/favicon.svg) is the same mark in white on a royal-blue #1C58D9 disc, one file for both themes; its own comment says the disc is there for visibility on dark browser chrome, so I did not treat it as the app icon. Both files keep the source's preserveAspectRatio="none"; the cropped viewBox is square (24.95 x 24.96), so it doesn't distort.
license: Mattermost brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with Mattermost.
